name: Dripwell
author: E. T. Carter
description: A still cave pool mirrors a vault of clustered calcite stalactites rooted in the rock, their thin tips glowing rose, and a folded drapery striped peach and rose along the right wall, all lit from below by a lime spring at the left that glows up through the water. Drips ring out across the mirror, laps circle the stalagmites, and green vapour drifts up off the surface.

params.label: Pool glow
params.effect: How brightly the spring and the pool light the cave and shine through thin calcite.

params.label: Drips
params.effect: How often drips fall and send rings across the mirror; at zero the pool lies still.

params.label: Vapour
params.effect: How much glowing vapour rises off the water.
